title: Workshop reservation handoff
purpose: Enable visitors to reserve a place in a workshop.

scope.text: Let visitors reserve a place in a workshop.

requirements.text: Let visitors reserve a place in a workshop.

stories.text: As a visitor, I want to reserve a place in a workshop.
acceptance_criteria: Given a published workshop, when a visitor completes a reservation, then a place in that workshop is reserved for that visitor.

edge_cases.text: Recommendation: define behavior when more visitors attempt to reserve than the workshop can accommodate, since no capacity limit has been decided.
Recommendation: define behavior for a visitor who wants to change or cancel a reservation, since cancellation has not been decided.

dependencies.text: Whether reservations require payment, an account, a capacity limit or cancellation is undecided.

risks.text: No owner is assigned, so accountability for this feature is undetermined.
No release date is assigned, so delivery timing is undetermined.

success_metrics.text: Recommendation: verify that a visitor can complete a reservation for a workshop place and that the resulting reservation is observable in the system.

open_questions: Is there a capacity limit per workshop, and if so what is it?
Can reservations be cancelled, and under what conditions?
What is the target release date?
